form.label: CCDC | Detection Triage
form.description: Fast triage of common events. These are broad indicators, not fully validated CyberHawks alerts.

search.query: index=* (EventCode=1102 OR EventCode=104 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=4741 OR EventCode=7045 OR EventCode=4698 OR EventCode=4719) | table _time host EventCode Account_Name Message | sort -_time | head 100
index=* (EventCode=4625) | stats count by host,Account_Name,Source_Network_Address | sort -count
index=* ("Failed password" OR "Invalid user") | stats count by host,source | sort -count
index=* (sourcetype=mssql:xe OR sourcetype=mssql:audit) ("xp_cmdshell" OR "EXECUTE AS" OR "xp_dirtree") | table _time host _raw | sort -_time
